recipe.visualDefinition: A classic 1960s album cover featuring a three-quarter studio portrait of a male vocalist in a dark suit against a deep, textured teal-black background. The layout uses heavy, stacked sans-serif typography on the left and a small tracklist on the bottom right, creating a balanced but asymmetrical composition typical of mid-century record sleeves.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject gaze directed toward the left-aligned primary text
High-contrast white shirt and hands against dark suit and background
Yellow primary text providing a vibrant focal point against the cool-toned backdrop
Small-scale tracklist balancing the large-scale artist name
coreInvariants: Deep teal or charcoal textured background
Subject in a dark suit with a crisp white collar
Left-justified main title and artist name

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, cropped at the waist, gesturing with hands toward the center-left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The artist's face and the large yellow name text serve as dual anchors.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the artist's face, follows the gaze and hand gesture to the large yellow text, then drops to the tracklist in the lower right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark space on the left side provides a canvas for the primary typography.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between white elements and dark background; low saturation overall with a single punch of yellow.

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed in negative space next to subject
Overlaid on the subject's dark suit

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weights and scales of the same condensed sans-serif family.
graphicDevices: Small geometric logo badge in upper right

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, high-impact feel of the artist name.
Provides the authentic mid-century grotesque look for secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a man in a 1960s dark suit and white shirt, gesturing with his hands, set against a dark teal, textured studio backdrop. The lighting should be high-contrast, highlighting the face and hands while leaving the suit in deep shadow.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, stacked, condensed sans-serif text in golden yellow on the left side. Add a vertical list of song titles in small white condensed sans-serif text in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text yellow and condensed?
Is the background a dark, moody teal?
Is the subject gesturing toward the text?
Is the tracklist small and white in the bottom right?

mustRedesign: Original artist name and song titles
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the yellow text is left-aligned
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject(Portrait) + Background(Dark Teal Texture) + Typography(Condensed Sans-Serif) + Palette(Yellow/White/Teal) = Mid-Century Album Aesthetic
